#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""RoboPaint limited-mode trajectory. All pose targets are brush-tip world poses."""
import sys, json, math, pathlib
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = pathlib.Path('/app/output')
Q = np.array([-0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0], dtype=float)  # vertical brush, quaternion wxyz
DT = 0.05
MAX_STEP = 0.0055  # keep Cartesian target speed below the service's 0.25 m/s limit
r = Robot()


def status(label):
    s = r.status()
    print(label, json.dumps({k:s.get(k) for k in ('step','calls','control_steps','elapsed_s','done','reason')}), flush=True)
    return s


def get_tip():
    o = r.get_obs(cameras=('canvas_cam','practice_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'), video='none')
    return np.asarray(o.meta['proprio']['now'][7:10], float), np.asarray(o.meta['proprio']['now'][10:14], float)


def interp_pose_points(points, start=None, max_step=MAX_STEP):
    """Convert XYZ waypoints to 20 Hz xyz/quaternion rows with bounded step length."""
    if start is None:
        start, _ = get_tip()
    rows=[]; cur=np.asarray(start,float)
    for p in points:
        p=np.asarray(p,float)
        n=max(1, int(math.ceil(float(np.linalg.norm(p-cur))/max_step)))
        for f in np.linspace(1/n,1,n):
            xyz=cur+(p-cur)*f
            rows.append(np.r_[xyz,Q])
        cur=p
    return np.asarray(rows,np.float32)


def submit_rows(rows, note, video='none'):
    rows=np.asarray(rows,np.float32)
    # chunks stay within the 10 s submit limit at 20 Hz
    for i in range(0,len(rows),180):
        res=r.submit('ee_pose', rows[i:i+180], dt=DT, video=video,
                     cameras=('canvas_cam','practice_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'), note=note)
        print('submit', note, i, min(i+180,len(rows)), 'n',len(rows[i:i+180]),
              'plan',json.dumps(res.meta.get('plan',[]))[:1000], 'meta',
              {k:res.meta.get(k) for k in ('step','control_steps_chunk','done','time_left_s')}, flush=True)
        if res.done: raise RuntimeError('episode ended during '+note)
    return get_tip()[0]


def move(points, note, video='none'):
    p,_=get_tip()
    return submit_rows(interp_pose_points(points,start=p), note, video)


def line(start_xyz, end_xyz, z, note, hold=0):
    a=np.array([start_xyz[0],start_xyz[1],z],float)
    b=np.array([end_xyz[0],end_xyz[1],z],float)
    pts=[a,b]
    if hold: pts += [b]*hold
    return move(pts,note)


def save_obs(tag):
    from PIL import Image
    o=r.get_obs(cameras=('canvas_cam','practice_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'), video='none')
    for cam,img in o.last.items(): Image.fromarray(img).save(OUT/f'{tag}_{cam}.png')
    print(tag, 'tip',o.meta['proprio']['now'][7:10], 'time_left',o.meta.get('time_left_s'), flush=True)
    return o


if __name__ == '__main__':
    status('start')
    p,q=get_tip(); print('tip_start',p,'quat',q,flush=True)
    # Load the dry brush in the ink stone, whose surface is z=0.028 m.
    move([[-0.100,0.150,0.055],[-0.100,0.150,0.025],[-0.100,0.150,0.025],[-0.100,0.150,0.055]], 'load_ink')
    save_obs('loaded')
    # Three pressure samples on the unscored practice sheet; far-to-near rows.
    # Practice sheet center is (-0.100,-0.1856), size 227 x 99 mm.
    for idx,(x,z) in enumerate([(-0.075,0.018),(-0.100,0.012),(-0.125,0.016)]):
        y0,y1=-0.222,-0.150
        # Alternate direction to avoid crossing the previous line.
        if idx%2: y0,y1=y1,y0
        move([[x,y0,0.050],[x,y0,z],[x,y1,z],[x,y1,0.050]], f'practice_pressure_{idx+1}')
    save_obs('practice')
    status('calibration_done')

from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
T=np.asarray(Image.open('/app/target.png').convert('RGB'))
A=np.asarray(Image.open('/app/output/main_top_canvas_cam.png').convert('RGB'))
# The camera projects the 227.185 mm sheet to 888.3 px; center is image pixel 512.
# Resample main sheet from the calibrated camera crop into the exemplar's 1024x1024 raster.
scale=2344.588379/.60*0.227185/1024
# target-pixel centre u,v maps to camera x/y =512 + scale*(u-511.5)
# PIL crop/resampling uses edge coordinates; crop bounds from edge projection.
edge=2344.588379/.60*0.227185
lo=(1024-edge)/2; hi=lo+edge
ca=np.asarray(Image.fromarray(A).crop((lo,lo,hi,hi)).resize((1024,1024),Image.Resampling.BILINEAR).convert('RGB'))
# save view side-by-side composite, red = target, cyan = actual, white = overlap
mt=(T.mean(2)<100); ma=(ca.mean(2)<100)
out=np.zeros((1024,1024,3),np.uint8)+247
out[mt & ~ma]=[235,40,40]
out[ma & ~mt]=[0,175,220]
out[mt & ma]=[25,25,25]
Image.fromarray(out).save('/app/output/top_overlay.png')
print('ink pixels target/actual/intersection',int(mt.sum()),int(ma.sum()),int((mt&ma).sum()),'IoU',float((mt&ma).sum()/(mt|ma).sum()))
for u in [300,350,500,600,700]:
 for label,m in [('T',mt),('A',ma)]:
  ys=np.where(m[:,u])[0]
  # longest/available runs around target horizontal y range 280:390
  ys=ys[(ys>280)&(ys<390)]
  print(label,u,(int(ys.min()),int(ys.max())) if ys.size else None,end='; ')
 print()

from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
T=np.asarray(Image.open('/app/target.png').convert('RGB'))
A=np.asarray(Image.open('/app/output/main_final_canvas_cam.png').convert('RGB'))
# Perspective is normal pinhole above a planar sheet; use the reported canvas intrinsics and .60 m lens-to-paper distance.
edge=2344.588379/.60*.227185
lo=(1024-edge)/2; hi=lo+edge
ca=np.asarray(Image.fromarray(A).crop((lo,lo,hi,hi)).resize((1024,1024),Image.Resampling.BILINEAR).convert('RGB'))
mt=T.mean(2)<100; ma=ca.mean(2)<100
# constrain to the actual paper's likely glyph region for diagnosing the camera border/robot occlusion
roi=np.zeros_like(mt); roi[100:850,150:850]=1
mt &= roi; ma &= roi
best=(0,None,None)
for dy in range(-22,23):
 for dx in range(-22,23):
  shifted=np.zeros_like(ma)
  ys=slice(max(0,dy),min(1024,1024+dy)); yt=slice(max(0,-dy),min(1024,1024-dy))
  xs=slice(max(0,dx),min(1024,1024+dx)); xt=slice(max(0,-dx),min(1024,1024-dx))
  shifted[ys,xs]=ma[yt,xt]
  inter=np.count_nonzero(mt&shifted); union=np.count_nonzero(mt|shifted)
  score=inter/union
  if score>best[0]:best=(score,dx,dy)
print('target_area',int(mt.sum()),'actual_area',int(ma.sum()),'best IoU/dx/dy(px)',best)
# Coverage and stray within 1 mm (rough 4.5 px) using square-neighborhood dilation.
dx,dy=best[1:]
shifted=np.zeros_like(ma); ys=slice(max(0,dy),min(1024,1024+dy)); yt=slice(max(0,-dy),min(1024,1024-dy)); xs=slice(max(0,dx),min(1024,1024+dx)); xt=slice(max(0,-dx),min(1024,1024-dx)); shifted[ys,xs]=ma[yt,xt]
try:
 from scipy.ndimage import maximum_filter
 near_t=maximum_filter(mt.astype(np.uint8),size=9)>0
 near_a=maximum_filter(shifted.astype(np.uint8),size=9)>0
 print('precision/recall within 1mm, boundaryF',float((shifted&near_t).sum()/max(1,shifted.sum())),float((mt&near_a).sum()/max(1,mt.sum())))
except Exception as e: print('distance unavailable',repr(e))
out=np.zeros((1024,1024,3),np.uint8)+247
out[mt & ~shifted]=[235,40,40]
out[shifted & ~mt]=[0,175,220]
out[mt & shifted]=[25,25,25]
Image.fromarray(out).save('/app/output/final_overlay.png')
